name: plugin-build-and-deploy
description: Automated build, test, and deployment of VST3 plugin releases across all platforms

trigger.condition: Release tag pushed to repository (format: v*.*.*)

prerequisites.description: Version number in CMakeLists.txt matches release tag
All CI checks passing on main branch
Code signing certificates available in environment

steps.name: Validate release tag
steps.action: Verify release tag format and ensure it matches semantic versioning

steps.name: Build Windows release
steps.action: Build plugin for Windows (x64) in Release configuration
steps.command: cmake -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 -DJUCE_DIR="$JUCE_DIR" -B build-win && cmake --build build-win --config Release

steps.name: Build macOS release
steps.action: Build plugin for macOS (Universal Binary) in Release configuration
steps.validation: Check build-mac/VST3/Release/*.vst3 exists and contains both architectures

steps.name: Build Linux release
steps.action: Build plugin for Linux (x64) in Release configuration

steps.name: Sign binaries (if available)
steps.action: Code sign plugin binaries for Windows and macOS if signing certificates are available

steps.name: Run smoke tests
steps.action: Run basic smoke tests on built plugins to verify they load correctly

steps.name: Create release packages
steps.action: Package plugins with documentation for distribution
steps.validation: Check releases/*.zip exist for each platform
steps.expected_output: Release packages created in releases/ directory

steps.name: Generate release notes
steps.action: Extract release notes from CHANGELOG.md for this version
steps.command: awk '/^## v'$(git describe --tags)'$/,/^## v/ { if (!/^## v/ || NR==1) print }' CHANGELOG.md > releases/RELEASE_NOTES.md

steps.name: Create GitHub release
steps.action: Create GitHub release with built artifacts
steps.command: gh release create $(git describe --tags) releases/*.zip --title 'Release '$(git describe --tags) --notes-file releases/RELEASE_NOTES.md
steps.expected_output: Release created successfully with all artifacts

steps.name: Update documentation site
steps.action: Deploy updated documentation to project website
steps.validation: Check documentation site shows new version

steps.name: Delete release tag
steps.command: git tag -d $(git describe --tags) && git push origin :refs/tags/$(git describe --tags)

steps.name: Clean build artifacts
steps.action: Remove all build directories and release packages

steps.name: Notify team of rollback
steps.action: Post to team channel that release was rolled back
steps.command: echo 'Release $(git describe --tags) rolled back' | slack-cli post #releases

checks.name: GitHub release exists
checks.expected: Release with correct tag and all artifacts

checks.name: Artifacts downloadable
checks.method: Download release artifacts and verify integrity

checks.name: Documentation updated
checks.method: Check documentation site shows new version

checks.name: Plugins loadable
checks.method: Test that downloaded plugins load in DAW

conditions: Smoke tests fail on any platform

testing.test_environment: CI staging environment with mock release tags
testing.test_data: Test projects with various plugin configurations
